scientific_integrity: The proof supplies real-parameter quantifiers; exact-rational tests only check algebraic identities and selected examples. Literature comparisons are not independence or uniqueness certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact scale boundaries are for three variables, sample size two and positive equicorrelation only.
Small covariance perturbations retain strong concavity only for a fixed strict interior scale; no explicit perturbation radius or sharp perturbed endpoints are established.
The symmetric discrete selection instance is degenerate (all two-item determinants are equal); its perturbation neighborhood contains nondegenerate instances.
The historical 1996/1999 formulations were identified but not reviewed in complete primary text; equivalent unindexed prior work remains possible.
title: Sharp affine-slice concavity phases for three-point maximum-entropy sampling
